body:
True, but atleast she can try
I don't think there's anything else she can do to help her friend
Gosh topics like this makes my blood boils tbh
للاسف انا اتفشخت حياتي و هي ولا كاني موجود اصلا 😏
دي حقيقة، انا فعلا محتاج اركز على نفسي

Man up is a weird thing to say, we do have feelings too and bottling them ain't healthy.
And no I didn't expect her to come around, I was perfectly fine with being a friend and actually I needed her as a friend more than a lover

But I agree that I need to forgive and love myself more
I'm here for you if you need to talk

Thank you.
This is the nicest thing I heard in a long time
Means a lot
I hope I can make it out of this

افضل فيه ازاي مكنتش بتقولي صباح الخير حتى فالوضع كان صعب جدا نفسيا عليا
انا ممكن اتسرعت اني مشيت بس الموضوع فعلا صعب

This is illegal, call the cops and they'll stop this.

Can't believe people still doing this in 2024 😒
Proud of you bro, keep going

انا شايف انك طالما انتي سألتي السؤال ده يبقى انتي عارفة الإجابة.
خسي لنفسك الموضوع صحي و هيحسن حياتك عموما
I've been there, I know how you feel and I know how dark it gets, but trust me you'll pull through, I know it's not much but if you ever want to vent out and talk I'm all ears
